system_description.narrative_title: Iran-led regional conflict triggering a global diesel/oil shock
system_description.narrative_summary: A widening confrontation centered on Iran — including maritime attacks, shifts in Iranian tactics, and threats of US strikes — is disrupting Gulf oil and diesel flows, pushing prices higher and prompting emergency policy responses (IEA stock releases, sanctions, naval actions). These energy shocks create reinforcing feedbacks between market volatility, refinery and fuel shortages, shipping risk, and political incentives around elections, raising risks of prolonged supply stress and wider economic spillovers.
system_description.scope: Inside the system: Iranian military strategy and proxy attacks (ships, facilities), Saudi/Houthi and Israel-related hostilities, shipping through Hormuz and Gulf sea lanes, crude/diesel production and exports, refinery operations and margins, strategic stockpile releases (IEA, SPRs), tanker movements and 'shadow fleet' dynamics, sanctions and financial measures, oil/diesel prices and trader sentiment, short-term consumer and industrial fuel supply impacts.
system_description.super_system: Global political-economy of energy and security — the international security architecture and global energy markets that govern trade flows, strategic reserves, and macroeconomic stability.
adjacent_subsystems: Global oil market and trading/financial infrastructure (traders, hedging, OPEC+ decisions)
Middle East regional security dynamics (state and non-state actors, deterrence, military options)
International maritime shipping, insurance and logistics (tankers, freight routes, shadow fleets)
Energy policy and crisis management institutions (IEA, national strategic reserves, sanctions regimes)

variables.name: Maritime attack rate
variables.description: The frequency of hostile actions (incidents per time) directed at commercial shipping and maritime energy infrastructure.

variables.name: Shipping transit risk
variables.description: The perceived and measured risk level for merchant vessel transits through key regional sea lanes and chokepoints.

variables.name: Crude export flow
variables.description: The rate of crude oil exports leaving the regional production basins (barrels per day).

variables.name: Diesel production rate
variables.description: The aggregate rate at which refineries produce diesel fuel for export and domestic use.

variables.name: Refinery utilization
variables.description: The percentage of refinery processing capacity that is currently in operation across the refining system.

variables.name: Global diesel stocks
variables.description: The total held inventory of diesel fuel available in commercial and strategic storage worldwide.

variables.name: Strategic reserve release rate
variables.description: The rate at which strategic oil or diesel reserves are being released into markets (volume per time).

variables.name: Tanker availability
variables.description: The effective availability of commercial tanker tonnage for transporting crude and refined products, including alternative/hidden capacity.

variables.name: Shipping insurance premiums
variables.description: The market price level of war-risk and hull insurance for tankers and merchant vessels on relevant routes.

variables.name: Oil price level
variables.description: The prevailing market price of benchmark crude oil expressed in currency per barrel.

variables.name: Oil price volatility
variables.description: The short- to medium-term variability (standard deviation/variance) of oil prices reflecting market uncertainty.

variables.name: Trader sentiment
variables.description: The aggregated market actors' confidence and risk appetite regarding future supply/demand and price trajectory.

variables.name: Sanctions restrictiveness
variables.description: The overall restrictiveness and enforcement intensity of economic and financial measures limiting trade and payment flows.

variables.name: Refinery margin level
variables.description: The spread between refined product prices and refinery feedstock costs expressed as a measure of refining profitability.

variables.name: Fuel supply-demand gap
variables.description: The instantaneous difference between available fuel supplies (production + imports + stocks) and aggregate consumption demand.

variables.name: Naval presence level
variables.description: The density and operational readiness of naval or security forces patrolling and escorting commercial sea routes in the region.

catalysts.title: IEA coordinated oil/diesel stock release
catalysts.description: International Energy Agency and partners release large crude and diesel volumes (including >20m barrels diesel) to ease market stress.
catalysts.rationale: IEA to speed up releases, says total stock release will exceed 400m barrels and 20m+ barrels diesel 'as soon as possible' (IEA headlines).

catalysts.title: U.S. solicits exchange of up to 17M SPR barrels
catalysts.description: U.S. solicitation to exchange up to 17 million barrels from the strategic reserve to supply markets and smooth prices.
catalysts.rationale: Headline: 'US solicits exchange of up to 17 million barrels of oil from strategic reserve' (2026-10-16).

catalysts.title: Iran-backed escalation of attacks on shipping before US vote
catalysts.description: Iran and proxies step up tactics targeting ships and routes in run-up to US vote, raising incident frequency and transit risk.
catalysts.rationale: Headlines: 'Iran shifting tactics to step up attacks on shipping before US vote' and 'Iran deploys new tactics to target ships' (2026-10-14).

catalysts.title: Potential U.S. strikes on Iran
catalysts.description: U.S. public statements and reporting indicate a nonzero chance of direct strikes against Iran, risking major escalation and retaliation.
catalysts.rationale: Rhetoric: 'Trump says US may need to strike Iran's Pickaxe Mountain' and reports US weighing large munitions (2026-10-16, 10-15).

catalysts.title: Policy moves on 'shadow fleet' tanker sanctions
catalysts.description: U.S. discussion of easing shadow-fleet sanctions could modestly alter tanker access but analysts expect limited near-term effect.
catalysts.rationale: Headline: 'US plan to ease shadow fleet sanctions unlikely to free up many tankers, analysts say' (2026-10-15).

catalysts.title: Iran continues clandestine fuel shipments
catalysts.description: Data shows Iran shipping LPG and jet fuel despite blockade, indicating ongoing covert export flows that partially offset shortages.
catalysts.rationale: Headline: 'EXCLUSIVE: Iran ships some LPG, jet fuel despite US blockade, data shows' (2026-10-16).

catalysts.title: Diesel squeeze expected to persist into 2027
catalysts.description: IEA and market reports warn diesel shortages will last well into 2027, maintaining tight markets and elevated margins.
catalysts.rationale: Multiple headlines: 'Diesel squeeze set to last well into 2027', 'Global diesel shortages could persist well into 2027, IEA says' (2026-10-14/15).
